E01-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E01-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(airport_id) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1
E01-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1

E02-SCH: SELECT iata_code FROM airports WHERE night_curfew = 1 ORDER BY iata_code
E02-BIZ: SELECT iata_code FROM airports WHERE night_curfew = 1
E02-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT a.airport_id FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.origin_airport_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id WHERE a.night_curfew = 1 AND ca.is_pilot_flying = 1
E03-CAS: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink'
E03-SCH: SELECT name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink' ORDER BY name
E03-BIZ: SELECT airline_id, name FROM airlines WHERE alliance = 'CargoLink'

E05-SCH: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'

E05-VAG: SELECT COUNT(aircraft_id) FROM aircraft WHERE ownership = 'leased'
E06-CAS: SELECT aircraft_id, status FROM aircraft WHERE status != 'active'
E06-SCH: SELECT tail_number, status FROM aircraft WHERE status != 'active'
E06-BIZ: SELECT status, aircraft_id, serial_number FROM aircraft WHERE status IN ('maintenance', 'retired')
E06-VAG: SELECT aircraft_id, tail_number FROM aircraft WHERE status = 'retired'

E07-SCH: SELECT loyalty_tier, COUNT(customer_id) FROM customers GROUP BY loyalty_tier

E08-SCH: SELECT name, city FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany'

E09-SCH: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(*) FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E09-BIZ: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(warehouse_id) FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E09-VAG: SELECT warehouse_type, COUNT(warehouse_id) FROM warehouses GROUP BY warehouse_type
E10-CAS: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'
E10-SCH: SELECT SUM(floor_area_m2) FROM warehouses WHERE warehouse_type = 'cold_chain'

M01-CAS: SELECT T1.airline_id, COUNT(T2.aircraft_id) AS plane_count FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN aircraft AS T2 ON T1.airline_id = T2.airline_id GROUP BY T1.airline_id ORDER BY plane_count DESC
M01-SCH: SELECT airlines.name, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) FROM airlines LEFT JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.name ORDER BY COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) DESC, airlines.name
M01-BIZ: SELECT airlines.airline_id, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) AS fleet_size FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.airline_id ORDER BY fleet_size DESC
M01-VAG: SELECT airlines.airline_id, COUNT(aircraft.aircraft_id) as aircraft_count FROM airlines JOIN aircraft ON airlines.airline_id = aircraft.airline_id GROUP BY airlines.airline_id
M02-CAS: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M02-SCH: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model ORDER BY T2.model
M02-BIZ: SELECT T2.model AS aircraft_type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M02-VAG: SELECT T2.model, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id WHERE T1.status = 'active' GROUP BY T2.model
M03-CAS: SELECT COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE origin_airport_id = (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST') AND status = 'completed'
M03-SCH: SELECT COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE airports.iata_code = 'IST' AND flights.status = 'completed'
M03-BIZ: SELECT SUM(fuel_uplifts.quantity_kg) FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN flights ON fuel_uplifts.flight_id = flights.flight_id JOIN airports ON flights.origin_airport_id = airports.airport_id WHERE airports.iata_code = 'IST' AND flights.status = 'completed'
M03-VAG: SELECT AVG(annual_cargo_capacity_t) FROM airports WHERE iata_code = 'IST'
M04-CAS: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY COUNT(flight_id) DESC LIMIT 5
M04-SCH: SELECT T1.origin_airport_id, T1.destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.origin_airport_id = T2.airport_id JOIN airports AS T3 ON T1.destination_airport_id = T3.airport_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.origin_airport_id, T1.destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-BIZ: SELECT leg_number, COUNT(*) as flight_count FROM flights JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY leg_number ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 5
M04-VAG: SELECT origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id, COUNT(*) as flight_count FROM flights GROUP BY origin_airport_id, destination_airport_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 10
M05-CAS: SELECT AVG(delay_minutes) FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed'
M05-SCH: SELECT aircraft.type_id, AVG((julianday(flights.actual_arrival) - julianday(flights.scheduled_arrival)) * 1440) AS avg_delay_minutes FROM flights JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY aircraft.type_id ORDER BY avg_delay_minutes DESC
M05-BIZ: SELECT AVG(incidents.delay_minutes) AS average_delay, airlines.name AS carrier_name FROM incidents JOIN flights ON incidents.flight_cargo_id = flights.flight_id JOIN airlines ON flights.airline_id = airlines.airline_id WHERE incidents.incident_type = 'delay' GROUP BY airlines.name
M05-VAG: SELECT name FROM airlines ORDER BY founded_year DESC LIMIT 1
M06-CAS: SELECT T1.airline_id, COUNT(T2.flight_id) FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airline_id = T2.airline_id WHERE T2.status = 'cancelled'
M06-SCH: SELECT aircraft.type_id, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM flights JOIN aircraft ON flights.aircraft_id = aircraft.aircraft_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY aircraft.type_id ORDER BY COUNT(flights.flight_id) DESC
M06-BIZ: SELECT airlines.airline_id, COUNT(*) AS cancellation_volume FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE flights.status = 'cancelled' GROUP BY airlines.airline_id
M06-VAG: SELECT cancellation_reason, COUNT(*) FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id WHERE cancellation_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cancellation_reason
M07-CAS: SELECT SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_co2_emissions_tonnes FROM airlines JOIN flights ON airlines.airline_id = flights.airline_id JOIN fuel_uplifts ON flights.flight_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id
M07-SCH: SELECT T4.name, SUM(T1.co2_emissions_kg / 1000) AS total_co2_emissions_k FROM fuel_uplifts AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.flight_id = T2.flight_id JOIN aircraft AS T3 ON T2.aircraft_id = T3.aircraft_id JOIN airlines AS T4 ON T3.airline_id = T4.airline_id GROUP BY T4.name
M07-BIZ: SELECT SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_co2_emissions_t FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airlines ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airlines.home_hub_airport_id
M07-VAG: SELECT SUM(fuel_uplifts.co2_emissions_kg) AS total_emissions_kg FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airlines ON fuel_uplifts.flight_id = flights.flight_id
M08-CAS: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre), airports.region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-SCH: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre), airports.region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-BIZ: SELECT AVG(fuel_uplifts.price_usd_per_litre) AS avg_price_per_litre, airports.region FROM fuel_uplifts JOIN airports ON fuel_uplifts.airport_id = airports.airport_id GROUP BY airports.region
M08-VAG: SELECT supplier_name, AVG(price_usd_per_litre) as average_price FROM fuel_uplifts GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY average_price DESC LIMIT 1
M09-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-SCH: SELECT T1.iata_code, COUNT(T2.warehouse_id) FROM airports AS T1 JOIN warehouses AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id GROUP BY T1.iata_code HAVING COUNT(T2.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-BIZ: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) >= 4
M09-VAG: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name ORDER BY warehouse_count DESC LIMIT 10
M10-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-SCH: SELECT T2.iata_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM warehouses AS T1 JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T1.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY T2.iata_code HAVING count > 1
M10-BIZ: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name HAVING COUNT(w.warehouse_id) > 1
M10-VAG: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(w.warehouse_id) AS bonded_warehouse_count FROM airports a JOIN warehouses w ON a.airport_id = w.airport_id WHERE w.is_bonded = 1 GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name
H01-CAS: SELECT a.airline_id, ac.aircraft_id, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS flight_count FROM airlines a JOIN aircraft ac ON a.airline_id = ac.airline_id JOIN flights f ON ac.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.airline_id, ac.aircraft_id ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H01-SCH: SELECT T1.tail_number, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.tail_number ORDER BY flight_count DESC, T1.tail_number ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT a.airline_id, a.aircraft_id, COUNT(f.flight_id) AS total_completed_flights FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f ON a.aircraft_id = f.aircraft_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND ca.assignment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.airline_id, a.aircraft_id ORDER BY total_completed_flights DESC LIMIT 1
H01-VAG: SELECT T1.name, T2.model, SUM(T3.quantity_kg) as total_fuel_loaded FROM airlines AS T1 JOIN aircraft_types AS T2 ON T1.home_hub_airport_id = T2.type_id JOIN fuel_uplifts AS T3 ON T1.home_hub_airport_id = T3.airport_id GROUP BY T1.name, T2.model ORDER BY total_fuel_loaded DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, f.airline_id, COUNT(*) as landing_count FROM airports a JOIN flights f ON a.airport_id = f.destination_airport_id JOIN crew_assignments ca ON f.flight_id = ca.flight_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' AND ca.assignment_status = 'completed' GROUP BY a.airport_id, f.airline_id ORDER BY landing_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-SCH: SELECT T3.iata_code, T2.name, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flights AS T1 JOIN airlines AS T2 ON T1.airline_id = T2.airline_id JOIN airports AS T3 ON T1.destination_airport_id = T3.airport_id WHERE T1.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T3.iata_code, T2.name ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT f.destination_airport_id AS airport_id, ar.airline_id, COUNT(*) AS completed_arrivals FROM flights f JOIN airports a ON f.destination_airport_id = a.airport_id JOIN airlines ar ON f.airline_id = ar.airline_id WHERE f.status = 'completed' GROUP BY f.destination_airport_id, ar.airline_id ORDER BY airport_id, completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT a1.airport_id, a2.airline_id, COUNT(a2.airline_id) FROM airports AS a1 JOIN airlines AS a2 ON a1.airport_id = a2.home_hub_airport_id JOIN crew_members AS c ON a2.airline_id = c.airline_id GROUP BY a1.airport_id, a2.airline_id ORDER BY COUNT(a2.airline_id) DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT invoice_number, issued_date, SUM(amount_usd) AS total_amount, SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE issued_date LIKE '2025%' GROUP BY invoice_number, issued_date
H03-SCH: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', issued_date) AS issued_date, SUM(amount_usd), SUM(SUM(amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY issued_date) AS running_total FROM invoices WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY issued_date
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date) AS month, SUM(invoices.amount_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(SUM(invoices.amount_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', invoices.issued_date)) AS cumulative_revenue FROM invoices JOIN payments ON invoices.invoice_id = payments.invoice_id WHERE strftime('%Y', invoices.issued_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flights WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) = date('now','-1 month')) - COUNT(*) AS change_from_previous_month FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND actual_departure IS NOT NULL
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)) AS previous_month_completed_flights, COUNT(*) - LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)) AS difference FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', actual_departure)
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) AS month, SUM(flight_cargo.total_volume_m3) AS completed_flight_volume_m3, (SUM(flight_cargo.total_volume_m3) - LAG(SUM(flight_cargo.total_volume_m3)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure))) AS month_over_month_change FROM flights JOIN flight_cargo ON flights.flight_id = flight_cargo.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' GROUP BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flights.actual_departure) AS month, COUNT(flight_id) FROM flights GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT T1.aircraft_id, AVG(CAST((strftime('%s', T2.actual_departure) - strftime('%s', T2.scheduled_departure)) AS REAL) / 3600) AS avg_ground_time FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T2.actual_departure IS NOT NULL AND T2.scheduled_departure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.aircraft_id ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT AVG(T2.actual_departure - T2.actual_arrival) AS avg_time_difference, T1.tail_number FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T2.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL AND T2.actual_departure IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T1.tail_number ORDER BY avg_time_difference ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT a.aircraft_id, AVG((julianday(f2.actual_departure) - julianday(f1.actual_arrival)) * 24) AS turnaround_time FROM aircraft a JOIN flights f1 ON a.aircraft_id = f1.aircraft_id JOIN flights f2 ON a.aircraft_id = f2.aircraft_id WHERE f1.status = 'completed' AND f2.status = 'completed' AND f1.flight_id < f2.flight_id GROUP BY a.aircraft_id ORDER BY turnaround_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(meta_value, 12), ' ', '') AS REAL)) AS avg_turnaround FROM benchmark_meta WHERE meta_key = 'turnaround_time'
H06-CAS: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_type, SUM(i.amount_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) AS share FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_type HAVING SUM(i.amount_usd) > ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) * 0.04
H06-SCH: SELECT c.name AS customer, (SUM(p.amount_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd)) * 100 AS percentage FROM customers c JOIN shipments s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id JOIN invoices i ON s.shipment_id = i.shipment_id JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING percentage > 4
H06-BIZ: SELECT T1.account_code, SUM(T2.amount_usd) AS revenue, SUM(T2.amount_usd) * 100 / ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) AS share FROM customers AS T1 JOIN invoices AS T2 ON T1.customer_id = T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.account_code HAVING SUM(T2.amount_usd) * 100 / ( SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM invoices ) > 4
H06-VAG: SELECT c.customer_id, c.account_code, c.name, SUM(p.amount_usd) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id JOIN payments p ON i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.account_code, c.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10
H07-CAS: SELECT a.airport_id, SUM(s.chargeable_weight_kg) AS total_cargo_tonnes FROM airports a JOIN flight_cargo fc ON a.airport_id = fc.origin_airport_id JOIN shipments s ON fc.shipment_id = s.shipment_id GROUP BY a.airport_id ORDER BY total_cargo_tonnes DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT T1.airport_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(T3.total_weight_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM airports AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.origin_airport_id JOIN flight_cargo AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id JOIN shipments AS T4 ON T3.shipment_id = T4.shipment_id WHERE T3.leg_status = 'flown' GROUP BY T1.airport_id HAVING rank BETWEEN 1 AND 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT T1.airport_id, SUM(T2.weight_kg) AS total_tonnage FROM airports AS T1 JOIN tracking_events AS T2 ON T1.airport_id = T2.airport_id WHERE T2.event_code = 'DEP' GROUP BY T1.airport_id ORDER BY total_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT a.airport_id, a.name AS airport_name, COUNT(c.declaration_id) AS export_count FROM airports a JOIN customs_declarations c ON a.airport_id = c.airport_id WHERE c.declaration_type = 'export' GROUP BY a.airport_id, a.name ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 1
H08-CAS: SELECT aircraft_types.model, COUNT(flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id JOIN fuel_uplifts ON flights.flight_id = fuel_uplifts.flight_id WHERE flights.status = 'completed' AND fuel_uplifts.fuel_burned_kg > aircraft_types.max_volume_m3 / 2
H08-SCH: SELECT T1.model, COUNT(*) FROM aircraft_types AS T1 JOIN flight_cargo AS T2 ON T1.type_id = T2.type_id JOIN flights AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id JOIN shipments AS T4 ON T2.shipment_id = T4.shipment_id WHERE T3.status = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.model HAVING SUM(T4.total_volume_m3) > 0.5 * T1.max_volume_m3
H08-VAG: SELECT aircraft_types.model FROM aircraft JOIN aircraft_types ON aircraft.type_id = aircraft_types.type_id JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id WHERE (flights.actual_departure IS NOT NULL AND flights.actual_arrival IS NOT NULL) AND (flights.takeoff_weight_kg / aircraft_types.max_payload_kg) BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55
H09-CAS: SELECT aircraft_id FROM aircraft WHERE home_airport_id IN (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1) AND aircraft_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT aircraft_id FROM shipments WHERE origin_airport_id IN (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)) GROUP BY aircraft_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT origin_airport_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-SCH: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.tail_number) FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN flights AS T2 ON T1.aircraft_id = T2.aircraft_id JOIN crew_assignments AS T3 ON T2.flight_id = T3.flight_id WHERE T2.status = 'completed' AND T3.assignment_status = 'completed' AND T2.destination_airport_id IN (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1)
H09-BIZ: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aircraft_id) FROM aircraft WHERE aircraft_id IN (SELECT aircraft_id FROM flights WHERE status = 'completed' AND origin_airport_id IN (SELECT airport_id FROM airports WHERE is_cargo_hub = 1))
H09-VAG: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT flights.flight_id) FROM aircraft JOIN flights ON aircraft.aircraft_id = flights.aircraft_id
H10-CAS: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) AS tax_count FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND (duty_rate_pct + vat_amount_usd / customs_value_usd) * 100 > 20
H10-SCH: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) as import_count FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND duty_amount_usd + vat_amount_usd > 0.2 * customs_value_usd
H10-BIZ: SELECT customs_country, COUNT(*) FROM customs_declarations WHERE declaration_type = 'import' AND vat_amount_usd / customs_value_usd > 0.20
H10-VAG: SELECT SUM(customs_declarations.vat_amount_usd) FROM customs_declarations JOIN warehouses ON customs_declarations.warehouse_id = warehouses.warehouse_id WHERE customs_declarations.declaration_type = 'import' AND warehouses.security_level = 'high'
